name: Fly idle machine stop (every app in the org)

knobs.note: no static default — the script computes it ($(date -u +%s)). Read by bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh as ${FLY_IDLE_REAPER_NOW:-$(date -u +%s)}: the clock the lane measures idle seconds, the no-signal age and the stop row's time from. A test seam. NOT settable from the control plane — only env/global.env on the box moves it. The thresholds are settings rows, not knobs: fly.idle_stop_after_s (900, and fly.idle_stop_after_s.<app>), fly.idle_nosignal_alert_s (3600), fly.idle_fail_alert_after (3), fly.idle_max_stops_per_pass (10).
